ops.oldText: on a take-or-pay basis, without reduction or termination rights.
ops.newText: on a take-or-pay basis. This commitment is subject to Customer's termination and reduction rights under this Agreement, including Section 9.4, and the annual minimum will be reduced pro rata for any Services terminated or reduced in accordance with those rights.

input.comment: [Playbook] We conformed the three-year take-or-pay minimum to our termination rights so it cannot override the 30-day convenience termination and pro-rata refund we agreed in Section 9.4. Our playbook requires a customer convenience exit without penalty in any multi-year term; if helpful, we can instead cap the exposure on early exit at three months' fees.
input.summary: Make the § 2.1 take-or-pay commitment subject to Customer's § 9.4 convenience termination, with pro-rata reduction of the minimum.
